"''It takes one to know one, Luthen.|Cleave and Luthen Rael discuss Luthen's ring|audio=Cleave-Luthen-WhatAFestiveEvening.flac|}} '''Cleave''' was a [[human]] that attended an art exhibition hosted by [[Davo Sculdun]] in [[3 BBY]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Cleave appeared in "[[What a Festive Evening]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor's'']] [[Andor Season 2|second season]], which premiered on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} He was performed by [[Nicholas Day]]. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=クリーヴ（人間） |ka=კლივი }} [[Category:Antiques dealers]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
